description: This file defines the interface LoanScheduleModelPeriod, which models a period in a loan schedule, providing methods to access period details, amounts due, and other related behavior within the context of loan amortization schedules.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the period to a data transfer object encapsulating its data.

methods.name: isRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the period is a repayment period.

methods.name: isDownPaymentPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the period is a down payment period.

methods.name: periodNumber
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the period.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date for the period.

methods.name: principalDue
methods.description: Returns the principal amount due for the period.

methods.name: interestDue
methods.description: Returns the interest amount due for the period.

methods.name: addLoanCharges
methods.description: Adds fee and penalty charges to the period.

methods.name: isRecalculatedInterestComponent
methods.description: Checks if the interest component has been recalculated.

methods.name: addPrincipalAmount
methods.description: Adds principal amount to the period.

methods.name: addInterestAmount
methods.description: Adds interest amount to the period.

methods.name: getLoanCompoundingDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details of loan interest compounding.

methods.name: setEMIFixedSpecificToInstallmentTrue
methods.description: Marks the EMI as fixed specific to an installment.

methods.name: isEMIFixedSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the EMI is fixed specific to an installment.
